title: Character Styles — Visual Guides
style: Approved G-Art soft-pastel pencil sketch layout, five meaningful visual stages, clear original characters, no borrowed slogans or watermarks.

items.title: Draw a Manga-Inspired Face
items.palette: soft blush pink, warm ivory, charcoal graphite
items.artDirection: Five connected drawings of ONE invented face: briefly show an already-known base head, then compare three original expressive eye designs, grouped hair silhouettes, restrained line weights, and final style variations. The core lesson is stylization choices, NOT repeating basic facial proportion construction.
items.qualityChecks: Show the same clearly invented adult/teen character across steps, both eyes aligned to the head turn.

items.title: Build a Manga-Inspired Character
items.artDirection: Begin from an already-constructed neutral standing figure, then show head-unit ratio choices, expressive silhouette/gesture exaggeration, an original outfit shape, and one complete original stylized character. Include a side-by-side proportion comparison; do NOT repeat the basic five steps of the general standing-figure lesson.
items.qualityChecks: Include whole body and feet without clipping. Keep hand count and joint connections correct.

items.title: Try a Webtoon-Inspired Character
items.palette: warm peach, dusty rose, muted sage
items.artDirection: Five stages for the same invented character: head and body, gentle features, flowing hair and outfit, flat color groups, shadow and light. Bonus five small expressions.
items.qualityChecks: Use one interpretation as a creative example, not a uniform claim about Korean artists.

items.title: Explore Flowing Ink-Inspired Lines
items.palette: ivory, ink gray, restrained pale jade
items.artDirection: Five stages: gesture, head and body shapes, costume silhouette, light/dark ink masses, selective flowing linework. Five optional brush marks or fabric details.
items.qualityChecks: Use a fresh fictional character and original costume design; not an attribution or imitation of a living artist's signature character.

items.title: Make a Cartoon Character from Shapes
items.palette: soft apricot, muted sky blue, sage and peach
items.artDirection: Five stages: choose shape language, gesture, body forms, bold outline, expression and color. Five playful but anatomically credible silhouettes.
items.qualityChecks: Western comics and cartoons are varied; make an original friendly character rather than treating one design as the sole style.
